name: DNA double-strand break and crosslink repair
rationale: Members cover DSB sensing, HR/BRCA-PALB2, NHEJ, SSA/MMEJ, fork protection and Fanconi/ICL repair, unlike the broader confusable that adds base excision, mismatch and nucleotide excision repair or the telomere-focused ones.

name: Chemokine-driven dendritic cell chemotaxis and maturation
rationale: Members combine chemokine-receptor binding modules with CCR7-linked dendritic cell chemotaxis, maturation and survival, which the monocyte-differentiation and lymphocyte-homing confusables lack.

name: IRF3-mediated type I interferon induction
rationale: All three members concern IRF3-driven activation of type I IFN, distinct from RIG-I/MDA5 sensing, TLR9-IRF7 and IFN-receptor signaling confusables.

name: Vitamin K-dependent protein gamma-carboxylation
rationale: Members describe vitamin K response and gamma-carboxylation, propeptide removal and ER-Golgi transport of carboxylated precursors, not the coagulation cascade itself.

name: Arterial endothelial differentiation and dorsal aorta morphogenesis
rationale: All members concern arterial endothelial cell specification and dorsal aorta formation, versus cardiac valve, endocardium and outflow tract confusables.

name: Striated muscle adaptation to activity and inactivity
rationale: Members cover atrophy, response to muscle (in)activity, fiber-type switching and cardiac adaptation/growth, unlike myogenesis, cell-size and calcineurin-hypertrophy confusables.

name: Hedgehog signal transduction through SMO and GLI
rationale: Members cover SMO activation, ciliary localization and GLI processing/degradation/transcription, distinct from Hh ligand lipidation and from floor plate, planar polarity and left-right confusables.

name: Sphingolipid biosynthesis and amyloid precursor protein regulation
rationale: Members combine de novo sphingolipid/sphingomyelin synthesis and amide/membrane lipid regulation with negative regulation of APP synthesis and catabolism, which separates it from amyloid-fibril and sphingolipid-catabolism confusables.

name: NADPH-dependent ROS and reactive aldehyde detoxification
rationale: Members link ROS detoxification and redox homeostasis to NADPH regeneration via isocitrate, plus methylglyoxal/aldehyde detoxification and protein repair, unlike glutathione/ferroptosis, sulfur and vitamin C confusables.

name: Death receptor apoptosis, necroptosis and non-NLRP3 inflammasome pyroptosis
rationale: Members span FAS/TRAIL/TNFR1-caspase-8 apoptosis, RIPK1/TRIF necroptosis and AIM2/NLRP1/IPAF/CASP4/5 pyroptosis with IL-18, distinct from NLRP3/IL-1 and mitochondrial apoptosis confusables.

name: Pancreatic and neuroendocrine progenitor lineage differentiation
rationale: Members concern pancreatic progenitor and NEUROG3+ endocrine lineages, alpha cell, exocrine, adrenal and neuroendocrine differentiation, versus endoderm-formation and gastrulation confusables.

qualifier: NK and T cell, inhibitory control
name: NK and T cell cytotoxic activation and inhibitory control
rationale: Members cover NK receptor/KIR and T cell activation signatures, cytotoxicity, granzyme killing and its positive and negative regulation including tolerance and anergy, beyond the Th1/Treg, cytokine-production and DC-signature confusables.

name: Fatty acid elongation and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members cover very long-chain and polyunsaturated (LA/ALA) fatty acyl-CoA elongation plus plasmalogen and wax synthesis, unlike peroxisomal oxidation, import and cholesterol synthesis confusables.

name: Regulation of cholesterol efflux and reverse cholesterol transport
rationale: All members regulate cholesterol efflux, storage, foam cell formation and HDL-mediated reverse transport, versus confusables centred on cholesterol import, HDL assembly and lipoprotein remodeling.

name: Phospholipid scrambling, phosphatidylserine exposure and apoptotic cell clearance
rationale: Members link calcium-activated scrambling and aminophospholipid translocation to PS exposure, recognition and engulfment of apoptotic cells, unlike flippase-trafficking, foam cell and surfactant confusables.

name: Cysteinyl leukotriene synthesis and eicosanoid receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover LTC4/LTD4 synthesis and transport, leukotriene and prostanoid GPCRs, distinct from lipoxin/LTB4 catabolism, histamine and prostaglandin-synthesis confusables.

name: Proximal TCR signaling in T cell activation and differentiation
rationale: Members include CD3/zeta phosphorylation, ZAP-70 translocation, ITK/PKC and T cell activation modules driving CD8 and gamma-delta differentiation, versus confusables with CD28 costimulation, downstream TCR or thymocyte/B cell modules.

name: Leading-edge protrusion, membrane ruffling and macropinocytosis
rationale: Members regulate lamellipodia, ruffles, pseudopodia, podosomes and macropinocytosis at the cell leading edge, which actin-nucleation, Rho GTPase and actin-network confusables lack.

name: Circadian and PGC-1alpha transcriptional control of energy metabolism
rationale: Members join BMAL1/CLOCK, ROR/REV-ERB and heme signaling with PGC-1alpha, PPARA, mitochondrial biogenesis, thermogenesis and beta-cell regulation, versus core clock-protein, gluconeogenesis and adipogenesis confusables.

name: Cardiac contractility via sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium uptake
rationale: Members regulate heart contraction force, rate and relaxation with SERCA-type SR calcium import and ATPase activity, unlike confusables centred on SR calcium release, membrane potential or hypertrophy.

name: TLR-driven IKK activation and non-canonical NF-kB signaling
rationale: Members cover IRAK/TRIF/TRAF6-mediated TAK1 and IKK activation, TBK1-IRF3/7 and NIK non-canonical NF-kB with IKK deficiencies, distinct from TNFR1, lymphocyte and negative-regulation confusables.

name: ADP-ribosylation and chromatin remodeling at DNA damage sites
rationale: Members combine poly-ADP-ribosylation cycles, nucleosome organization, CHD remodelers and chromatin recruitment at damage sites, unlike the HR/NHEJ repair, telomere and replication confusables.

name: GPCR-driven platelet activation via G12/13-Rho signaling
rationale: Members cover P2Y1/P2Y12, PAR, TP and prostacyclin receptor signaling with G12/13-Rho, versus GPVI, VWF, degranulation and coagulation confusables.

name: Cellular responses to gonadotropins and GnRH
rationale: All members concern glycoprotein hormone receptors and responses to FSH, LH and GnRH, unlike confusables on activin signaling, gonadotropin secretion and gonad development.

name: Iron uptake and BACH1-HMOX1 metal stress response
rationale: Members combine iron import and homeostasis with BACH1/HMOX1 regulation and responses to lead, cobalt, selenium and peroxide, distinct from zinc, copper, cadmium and heme-scavenging confusables.
